skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics of advertising agencies, types of advertising agencies, and the market for advertising agencies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic issues in advertising agency management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic issues in advertising agency management.
Understand various organizational structures and suitable organizational structures for advertising agencies.
Understand the nature and methods of managing customer relationships in advertising agency operations.
Understand the nature and methods of managing human resources in advertising agencies.
Understand the nature of creativity and how to manage it in advertising agency operations.
Understand basic financial concepts in advertising agency operations.
Apply financial concepts to understand the operation and activities of advertising agencies.
Know how to evaluate the effectiveness of advertising agency operations through financial and business indicators.
Be proactive in learning, researching, and collaborating with group members.
Be proactive in selecting and analyzing business problems of advertising agencies.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
